title: Editor events
doc: Event types and their folders in the level editor's event list; the game itself does not read this file.

sections.name: #Events
sections.doc: Entries are found by searching for the exact text $Event Name:, so the folder headers (#Trigger, #AI_Actions, ...) and their #End lines are skipped.

fields.name: $Event Name:
fields.doc: Event type name; it must be one the editor knows.

fields.name: $RFE Level1:
fields.doc: Folder of the event in the editor's list; searched for before the next $Event Name:.
